item.title: City council moves toward adding surveillance regulation to city code
item.description: City council members took a big step toward creating a framework for how the city of Austin uses surveillance technology.

item.title: Venus Williams to play ATX Open
item.description: Williams accepted a wild card into the ATX Open, the tournament announced Wednesday. The ATX Open is scheduled to take place from February 21 to March 1 at Westwood Country Club.

item.title: Hays County judge calls for immediate water restrictions to 'safeguard our collective future'
item.description: Hays County Judge Ruben Becerra said Wednesday that "all water supply corporations, municipal providers, and groundwater districts" should implement Stage 4 water restrictions "immediately."

item.title: 14 women sue former pastor who had images, videos of their sexual abuse as children
item.description: A group of 14 women filed a lawsuit Tuesday in federal court against a former Baptist pastor convicted of possessing more than 105,000 pieces of child sexual abuse material (CSAM), which included recorded instances of the women's assaults.

item.title: DPS trooper indicted on aggravated assault charge in connection with 2023 shooting
item.description: A Texas Department of Public Safety trooper has been indicted on an aggravated assault charge in connection with a shooting in 2023.

item.title: Georgetown Palace Theatre suffers damage, cancels showings following winter storm
item.description: The Georgetown Palace Theatre said it suffered extensive damage during the winter storm that occurred at the end of January.

item.title: Fired professor says Texas A&M 'ran roughshod' over her rights in new lawsuit
item.description: Texas A&M University fired former professor Melissa McCoul after a student secretly recorded her discussing gender identity in class.

item.title: Neighbors concerned about new Flock license plate readers in north Austin
item.description: People in a north Austin neighborhood are raising concerns about new Flock license plate readers that have been installed and how the technology may be used to coordinate with federal law enforcement.

item.title: Affidavit: Former Travis County Tax Office employees tied to alleged registration fraud scheme
item.description: Two former employees in the Travis County Tax Office and an outside coordinator are under criminal investigation for an alleged fraud‑for‑profit vehicle registration scheme that bypassed inspection and emissions requirements, according to an affidavit obtained by KXAN.

item.title: Tensions flare at Austin meeting to discuss APD's relationship with ICE
item.description: Some Austin City Council members, along with Austin Police Chief Lisa Davis, held a community meeting to discuss concerns community members might have about APD's involvement with ICE.
